visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a light green collared shirt and a white analog watch with a beaded bracelet, speaks into a black microphone with a square logo plate marked 'Do2'. She is in a studio with warm lighting and a blurred indoor background containing a plant. (2) A man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark brown t-shirt, is shown in a medium shot. He is seated in front of a white bookshelf filled with books and small objects, gesturing with his hand near his temple while speaking. (3) The scene cuts between the woman and the man as they engage in a conversation. The man holds the microphone and uses hand gestures to emphasize points. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: Do嘴一下 | EP16. [Slogan]: 實習沒錢也要去? 有實習經驗幫助你一生! [Subtitle]: 去實習公司應該給薪水嗎? 如果去一個實習的話. (2) [Subtitle]: 公司要付費給我們嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 我覺得要看 我對這公司有沒有貢獻. 如果今天一家公司 它在外面找實習生 那我覺得這家公司就要 付這些實習生錢. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為它今天找實習生 應該是要找實習生 過來幫它 我今天不是說 我今天找實習生 我只是 要你們過來學習 我今天開個學校 我覺得應該沒有公司 在做這種事情. (5) [Subtitle]: 大部分的公司找實習生 應該就是要 你來來幫我做一些 可能比較初階的事 你幫我處理一些 可能比較小的東西 我還是要實習生 提供價值給公司嗎 那這些公司我覺得就 應該要付費. (6) [Subtitle]: 對我的立場也是 我覺得 實習就是要給配 我曾經看到一個 非常生氣的例子 就是那一間公司呢 它就明目張膽的 就是開缺 幫我剪輯呀什麼 什麼什麼的. (7) [Subtitle]: 它直接說 你來我是沒有給你薪水 可是你可以獲得 這些經驗 我就想說 可是 這個我真的看的好生氣喔. (8) [Variety]: (想找免費勞工就直接說🤨). (9) [Slogan]: 你覺得實習要給錢嗎? 留言跟我分享! [Subtitle]: 我就覺得不行 實習一定要給薪水.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Debate -> Personal Anecdote -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to spark a discussion about the ethics of unpaid internships. It uses a podcast-style debate format where the hosts argue that interns should be paid for the value they provide, ending with a personal anecdote to illustrate the unfairness of unpaid positions and an invitation for viewers to share their thoughts.
